req.title: Reject wrong method on /put
req.statement: The system shall respond with HTTP 405 for methods other than PUT on /put.

doc.reasoning: The requirement states that /put must return HTTP 405 for any method other than PUT. We need: (1) a positive test confirming PUT returns 200 with expected JSON payload keys, (2) negative tests for each non-PUT method (GET, POST, DELETE, PATCH, HEAD) returning exactly 405, and (3) boundary tests at the method-selection boundary (e.g., the method immediately adjacent in the allowed-methods list). Mutation resilience is achieved by asserting exact status codes (405 not >=400), checking both the allowed method succeeds (200) and disallowed methods fail (405), and verifying payload structure on the positive path.

tests.name: test_put_method_returns_200_with_expected_payload
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
Test client is created from app
actions: Send HTTP PUT request to /put with JSON body
expected: Response JSON contains keys: url, args, form, data, origin, headers, files, json
trace: R-HTTPBIN-007: PUT on /put must succeed with 2xx
view_put() route accepts only PUT method
get_dict returns url, args, form, data, origin, headers, files, json
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_put_method_returns_200_with_expected_payload():
    r = client.put('/put', json={"key": "value"})
    assert r.status_code == 200
    data = r.get_json()
    assert isinstance(data, dict)
    for key in ('url', 'args', 'form', 'data', 'origin', 'headers', 'files', 'json'):
        assert key in data, f"Missing key: {key}"
    assert data['json'] == {"key": "value"}

test_put_method_returns_200_with_expected_payload()

tests.name: test_decision_table_all_non_put_methods_return_405
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
Test client is created from app
actions: Send GET, POST, DELETE, PATCH requests to /put
trace: R-HTTPBIN-007: Decision table covers all method branches
Catches mutations that allow extra methods or block PUT
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_decision_table_all_non_put_methods_return_405():
    non_put_responses = [
        ('GET', client.get('/put')),
        ('POST', client.post('/put')),
        ('DELETE', client.delete('/put')),
        ('PATCH', client.patch('/put')),
    ]
    for method, r in non_put_responses:
        assert r.status_code == 405, f"{method} /put expected 405, got {r.status_code}"
    put_r = client.put('/put')
    assert put_r.status_code == 200

test_decision_table_all_non_put_methods_return_405()
